title: Feature Flag Matrix Spaghetti
pattern: Scattering raw string-based checks for multiple runtime feature flags across execution pipelines, resulting in complex nested conditional matrices.
why_bad: Creates combinatorial state explosions that are impossible to test in aggregate. It prevents dead-code elimination, blocks static refactoring, and forces developers to maintain obsolete logical pathways indefinitely.
detection: Nested conditional checks targeting a runtime configuration dictionary or feature flag broker in core rendering or business logic.
fix: Resolve feature flag paths into polymorphic strategies at the composition root during application startup, eliminating flag checks from operational functions.
source: Titus Winters, Tom Manshreck, Hyrum Wright - *Software Engineering at Google_ Lessons Learned from Programming Over Time* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 24; Kent Beck - *Tidy First?* (2023, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 28.
